ONE APP. THE REAL LIST, NOT THE STORE’S.
LOCATION (WHILE USING) Where the device is now. Map and run stick. Messenger sometimes, when sharing. Torch and game, no.
LOCATION ALWAYS / BACKGROUND It tracks with the screen off. Almost never a slice. Delivery and a run, only if Tuesday asks. The rest is the house’s map.
CAMERA It sees the room. Photo, messenger (the photo you send), bank (the document). Torch, weather and game: no.
MICROPHONE It hears. A call and a voice note. Bank, almost never. A game ‘for chat’: refuse or turn off outside the match.
CONTACTS The house’s book. Messenger, if you choose. Bank and torch: no. Whoever takes the book takes the family’s map.
SMS / CODE It reads the bank code. Only the bank app, if the institution still asks. Messenger and game: no. Scams love this permission.
PHONE / CALL LOG Whom you call. The Phone app sticks. Messenger, sometimes. The rest: no. The log is a biography.
PHOTOS / FILES The gallery and the PDF. Photo and messenger (the image you pick, not the whole folder). Bank: that one document.
NOTIFICATIONS It shows on the lock screen. Messenger and bank: yes, a blind body. Game and weather: if it wakes the table, it goes.
OVERLAY / DRAW OVER It paints over another app. A bank scam uses this. Torch and weather: never. Messenger: almost never.
ACCESSIBILITY It reads the screen and taps for you. A real accessibility tool, or a spy. Game, VPN, ‘cleaner’: refuse. Always.
DEVICE ADMIN It locks, wipes, runs the device. A real company, or a hostage. An ordinary store app: refuse.
IGNORE BATTERY SAVER It stays awake. Messenger, sometimes. Game and torch: no. Eternal background is a map.
NEARBY DEVICES / BLUETOOTH It sees what is beside you. Earbuds and a watch stick. Weather and game: no. A Bluetooth name is already the digital field.
